questions.text:
Name the large natural environment you have studied this year. The environment can be in New Zealand or overseas and can be at a national, regional, or continental scale.

Explain how your chosen large natural environment is formed and changes over time.

You may include diagrams and maps in your answer.

questions.markingGuide: Achievement: Explains aspects of the large natural environment's formation and change with some evidence. Merit: Explains in detail the formation and changes over time with detailed case study evidence. Excellence: Fully explains formation and changes over time using geographic terminology and concepts, showing insight, with comprehensive case study evidence.

questions.text: Explain how one person or group's perception of your chosen large natural environment has changed over time.
